specs.title: CONTRACT-01: Context creation strictly preserves ownerId and sessionId
CONTRACT-02: Operations succeed when ownerId and sessionId match exactly
CONTRACT-03: Cross-owner access returns CONTEXT_ACCESS_DENIED and state remains unchanged
CONTRACT-04: Cross-session access of same owner returns CONTEXT_ACCESS_DENIED
CONTRACT-05: Candidate filtering completely excludes contexts of other sessions
CONTRACT-06: Action dispatch boundary strictly verifies session identity
CONTRACT-07: Cross-session cancellation is strictly denied
CONTRACT-08: Zero information leakage on cross-owner context query
CONTRACT-09: Mandatory SessionIdentity enforcement on all context APIs
CONTRACT-10: listContexts and getExecutionLogs strictly isolate records by session
E2E-OWNERSHIP-01: Session B cannot access or resolve Context of Session A via explicit entity
E2E-OWNERSHIP-02: Unaddressed slot utterance from Session B does not mutate Session A context
E2E-OWNERSHIP-03: Unaddressed cancellation from Session B does not cancel Session A context
E2E-OWNERSHIP-04: Identical orderId across distinct sessions maintains separate contextId and isolation
E2E-OWNERSHIP-05: Ambiguity calculation is scoped strictly within current session boundaries
E2E-OWNERSHIP-06: Explicit cancellation targeting foreign context is denied
